messages:
Anna (PM): Heads-up: enterprise customer wants us to cert a private deployment for 10k tenants, sustained 50 qps, with minimal upgrade downtime. Need packaging plan and acceptance criteria. Who owns installer limits? cc @Vikram
Vikram (Eng): Got it. Two clarifying q's: SLA p95 targets? tenant activity distribution (steady vs spiky)?
Anna (PM): Customer: warm-cache p95 ~200ms, cold/uncached up to 500ms. pattern: mostly steady with occasional bursts to 200 qps for a subset.
Kevin (Runtime): Our operator defaults assume ~1k active tenants/node. For 10k we need operator sharding and shared KV cache. Memory for KV cache and cache population during upgrades are the blockers.
Jen (Field Ops): Customer infra: 512GB hosts, NVMe local, but limited headcountthey want to avoid many nodes. Prefer minimal operator footprint.
Sam (Solutions): Suggest hybrid: noisy tenants routed to dedicated pools, others on shared pool. Installer must support an opt-in for dedicated-pool profiles.
Vikram (Eng): I can add installer knobs: operatorScalingPolicy and tenantAffinity flags. Need safe defaults so users don't misconfigure.
Anna (PM): Proposal: three install profiles: compact (single/small), scale (sharded multi-node), isolated (dedicated tenant pools). Include upgrade path compact->scale with zero-downtime operator rollouts.
Kevin (Runtime): For compact->scale we need warm-repopulate for shared-kv to avoid cold-cache spikes. Installer should expose orchestration hooks to repopulate caches and validate.
Jen (Field Ops): Need a preflight tool that simulates 10k tenants and validates networking, DNAT/NAT, and throughput. Can we ship a small job image that checks host networking?
Sam (Solutions): We have hosted loadgen; repack as ghcr image with a net-config-check wrapper. ops-bot, confirm artifact?
ops-bot: deploy-check OK  ghcr.io/redwood/loadgen:scale-harness-2026-03-01 exists
Sam (Solutions): Preflight example:
./preflight --tenants 10000 --qps 50 --duration 600 --check-latency
Vikram (Eng): Acceptance criteria draft:
- registry populated with 10k tenant entries
- sustain 50 qps across tenants for 10 minutes with p95 < 500ms
- warm-cache p95 < 250ms
- rolling upgrade compact->scale with <1% request loss and auto-fallback if cache attach fails
Kevin (Runtime): Also include per-tenant memory profiling and packaging guidance for model artifact sizing. Add opt-in /etc/redwood/shared-kv.yaml toggled by profile.
Jen (Field Ops): Rollback runbook: if operator can't attach to shared-kv, auto-fallback to local per-tenant cache, cordon nodes, alert on pager. Need explicit commands in runbook.
Sam (Solutions): I'll PR the wrapper image and sample configs.
Vikram (Eng): Rough schedule: shared-kv warm-repopulate spike 3 sprints, preflight + docs 1 sprint, joint validation 2 weeks.
Anna (PM): Decisions: create install profiles (compact/scale/isolated); add operatorScalingPolicy & tenantAffinity; implement shared-kv warm-repopulate; ship preflight harness; publish upgrade/rollback runbooks. I'll file RFC and tickets.
Jen (Field Ops): I'll book customer validation next Tue; need test creds and sanitized dataset.
Kevin (Runtime): I'll add Grafana panels for tenant-count vs memory and p95 in staging.
Anna (PM): Thanks team. If no blockers Ill move this into the private-deploy roadmap and assign owners.
Vikram (Eng): :+1:
Kevin (Runtime): :thumbsup:
Jen (Field Ops): :rocket:
